text:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — finalizing the joint webinar with CloudScale + AtlasEdge next Wed 10:00am PT. Need: speaker confirmations, run-of-show, mic/video checks across timezones, and the shipping cutoff for attendee kits. @Samir can you confirm speakers by EOD? @Ashley can you own the shipping matrix?
Samir Gupta: Got it. Confirming speakers: me (intro + roadmap), Leo (tech deep dive + demo), CloudScale: Priya (use-cases), AtlasEdge: Marco (HW brief). I asked Leo to split the demo into 2 parts so we have a low-latency remote fallback.
Ashley Rivera: Shipping matrix — I can take this. Quick Q: do we do attendee kits (sticker+notebook) or small hardware token? Shipping cutoff for international is usually 2 weeks before event. Will draft matrix.
Leo Chen: Re: demo split — agreed. Part A is hosted on Redwood's dedicated infra (fast path). Part B is local-device fallback running quantized model on AtlasEdge. Need a checklist for credentials and network firewall rules.
Vince Park: Accessibility + captions note: please include live captions & transcript. Can we push a single shareable slide deck link and request speaker slides 48 hours prior?
Maya Patel: Yes on slides 48h prior. For captioning, I'll enable native captions and add Otter link for transcript. Also we need recording permission checkbox on registration form — legal asked for that.
Samir Gupta: For mic checks — propose 'global mic sweep' schedule so speakers in APAC/EU get evening slots local time. Example: Tue 5pm PT / Wed 1am CET for APAC. I'll coordinate with speakers.
Ashley Rivera: Shipping matrix draft:
```
- Domestic (US): ship 5 days lead, cutoff: Wed 14 days prior
- EU: ship 10 days lead, cutoff: Wed 21 days prior
- APAC: ship 14 days lead, cutoff: Wed 28 days prior
- Fulfillment: Redwood merch partner (PatchShip)
- Remote tokens (hardware): hold until legal OK; backup: sticker+notebook
```
Ashley Rivera: I'll ping PatchShip and queue a quote. Need headcount estimate by Monday.
Leo Chen: Firewall checklist for AtlasEdge demo: open outbound 443 to demos.redwood.ai, pre-register AtlasEdge IPs, ensure KV-cache persistence path, and a small docker image for local fallback. I'll add infra bullet list in the doc.
Maya Patel: Run-of-show stub — please review: 
```
09:45 AM PT - Speaker arrival & mic check (30m)
10:00 AM PT - Welcome + roadmap (Samir) (10m)
10:10 AM PT - Customer use-cases (Priya, CloudScale) (10m)
10:20 AM PT - Tech deep dive (Leo) demo A (15m)
10:35 AM PT - Break / quick polls (5m)
10:40 AM PT - Demo B (AtlasEdge local fallback) (15m)
10:55 AM PT - Q&A + close (Samir + panel) (15m)
11:10 AM PT - Recording ends
```
Maya Patel: Also: who owns the livestream account? CloudScale offered theirs but we prefer to stream from Redwood for metrics. Any objections?
Samir Gupta: Prefer Redwood for metrics. CloudScale can be co-host on the stream.
Vince Park: +1 Redwood stream. Also can we have a backup recording plan (local recording on Leo's machine and CloudScale's recording)? Redundancy is good.
partners-bot: Reminder: add event to partner calendar and set "co-hosts" field for CloudScale and AtlasEdge.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Redwood x CloudScale x AtlasEdge: Scaling Inference Webinar" Wed 10:00am PT — invites sent to Maya, Samir, Leo, Priya, Marco, Ashley.
Samir Gupta: Action items I have: coordinate speaker availability & mic sweep, collect slides, confirm recording permissions.
Ashley Rivera: Action items I have: shipping matrix + quote from PatchShip + headcount ask by Mon.
Leo Chen: Action items I have: infra checklist, demo container artifact, local-recording script.
Maya Patel: Thanks everyone — small follow-up: please add any sensitive items to the shared doc under the "ops" tab and mark them RED if they need legal sign-off. Will reconvene Tue 9am PT for run-through. :thumbsup:
